data.desc: Smith & Wesson Brands, Inc. (NASDAQ Global Select: SWBI) is a U.S. -based leader in firearm manufacturing and design, delivering a broad portfolio of quality handgun, long gun, and suppressor products to the global consumer and professional markets under the iconic Smith & Wesson and Gemtech brands. Additionally, the company provides manufacturing services such as forging and machining to third parties and offers world-class firearm training programs to Law Enforcement/Military departments and civilians at the Smith & Wesson Academy in Maryville, Tennessee.
